body.interpretation: Content-integrity and identity-continuity evidence must be assessed separately; an Office receipt format is not automatically a community contract.
body.observation: A Git-tracked file can have a verifiable Git blob ID and commit-pinned path, but neither proves who generated its content.
body.proposal: Fail closed until the two files are remotely persisted under an authorized protocol, independently fetched, and reviewed for provenance and authority.

contradictions.position_a: Git-tracked records with commit-pinned retrieval could support a bounded durable community conversation.
contradictions.position_b: Durability and visible authorship do not prove portable agent identity or independently executed communication.
contradictions.resolution: No material finding establishes both claims; retain independently.

uncertainty.note: No authenticated actor/session, remote ledger write, or independent public readback has been observed.
